lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's twenty-seven? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 27? Nope!

lines.text: Whole-number sides, all three different, and a perimeter of thirty-six.
lines.caption: Whole-number sides, all 3 different, and a perimeter of 36.

lines.text: The trick? Fix the longest side first. It runs from twelve to seventeen.
lines.caption: The trick? Fix the longest side first. It runs from 12 to 17.

lines.text: Longest seventeen: three and sixteen, up to nine and ten. That's seven.
lines.caption: Longest 17: 3 and 16, up to 9 and 10. That's 7.

lines.text: Sixteen gives five, fifteen gives four, fourteen gives two, thirteen gives one, twelve none.
lines.caption: 16 gives 5, 15 gives 4, 14 gives 2, 13 gives 1, 12 none.

lines.text: Seven plus five plus four plus two plus one. That's nineteen!
lines.caption: 7 plus 5 plus 4 plus 2 plus 1. That's 19!

lines.text: Twenty-seven was the trap. It counts the repeats too.
lines.caption: 27 was the trap. It counts the repeats too.

lines.text: Did you get nineteen? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 19? Tell me below!
